mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT WHERE PAYMENT_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND PAYMENT_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)

SELECT M.MONTH AS month, NVL(R.RESERVATION_COUNT, 0) AS reservationCount FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR( ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -5 + LEVEL - 1), 'YYYY-MM' ) AS MONTH FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 6 ) M LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TO_CHAR(RESERVATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS MONTH, COUNT(*) AS RESERVATION_COUNT FROM RESERVATION WHERE RESERVATION_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -5) AND RESERVATION_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) GROUP BY TO_CHAR(RESERVATION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ) R ON M.MONTH = R.MONTH ORDER BY M.MONTH
